profile.headline: Full-Stack Engineer & SAAS Founder | MEAN Stack · Angular · React · .NET Core | 20+ Years Building Enterprise Applications | AI Practitioner
profile.summary:
I'm a full-stack developer and founder with 20+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise-grade applications across healthcare, legal, logistics, fintech, and government sectors.
 
I specialize in the MEAN stack (MongoDB, ExpressJS, Angular, Node.js) and Microsoft technologies (.NET Core, C#, ASP.NET), and I've led development on systems handling hundreds of transactions per minute. I'm equally comfortable architecting solutions from the ground up or stepping into complex legacy codebases to modernize them.
 
As the founder of duesPlus.com, I build custom SaaS tools that automate business workflows,  from membership management to patient tracking to payment processing.
 
What sets me apart: I don't just write code. I bring business context, architectural thinking, and technical leadership to every engagement, bridging the gap between product owners, stakeholders, and engineering teams.

Core strengths:
 
Frontend: Angular 15–18, React, TypeScript, RxJS/NgRx, PrimeNG, Kendo UI
Backend: Node.js, ExpressJS, C#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, WCF
Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, SQS), Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub
Databases: SQL Server (T-SQL, stored procedures), MongoDB, Entity Framework Core
Payments: Stripe, PayPal, Amazon Pay
 
Orlando, FL | Open to remote opportunities

positions.title: Software Engineer III | Full-Stack Developer
positions.description:
Led frontend architecture and full-stack development on an enterprise application — a platform enabling all 50 states to aggregate and manage data at scale.
 
Designed and built the full MEAN stack application (MongoDB, ExpressJS, Angular, Node.js) supporting nationwide data aggregation
Automated CI/CD deployments to AWS EC2 using Jenkins and GitHub
Implemented AWS Lambda functions and SQS queues to schedule and process background jobs
Managed file ingestion pipelines for CSV and Excel uploads into MongoDB and AWS S3
Applied advanced state management with RxJS and NgRx
 
Tech: Angular, Node.js, ExpressJS, MongoDB, AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, SQS), Jenkins, Jira
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Enterprise Systems · Node.js · Express.js · MongoDB

positions.title: Software Engineer, Architect, and Founder
positions.description:
Founded and operate a software consultancy building custom applications for clients across healthcare, e-commerce, and nonprofit sectors.
 
Built duesPlus.com — a SaaS membership tracking and electronic bookkeeping platform using MEAN stack
Developed a patient information tracking system for a group home corporation
Designed and delivered an internet ordering system for medical supplier Nipro Diagnostics (C#, SQL Server)
Integrated AWS S3 storage and Node/Express APIs across multiple client projects
 
Tech: Angular, Node.js, ExpressJS, MongoDB, C#, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, AWS S3, Stripe, PayPal
positions.insights: Skills: MongoDB · Node.js · Express.js · Angular · C# · ASP.NET Core · Amazon S3 · Stripe Connect · PayPal

positions.title: Angular / React / React Native Developer
positions.description:
Delivered frontend and full-stack solutions for enterprise clients across legal, logistics, tax, and mobility sectors.
 
Built enterprise legal signup application using ReactJS and .NET Core APIs
Developed logistics application for the U.S. Armed Forces
Engineered mobile location application with secure protocols using ReactJS
Contributed to a tax platform for a Big 5 consulting firm
Implemented reusable UI component libraries with Angular and managed complex application state
 
Tech: Angular, ReactJS, React Native, .NET Core, TypeScript, D3.js
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · React.js · C# · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kendo Ui

positions.title: Sr. Programmer / Team Lead
positions.description:
Led a team of developers and served on the engineering leadership committee for a high-volume payment and retail technology company.
 
Architected a Payment Center application processing 600+ transactions per minute at peak load, used by MetroPCS vendors nationwide
Built a User Management System enabling role-based access for support agents, retailers, branches, and master dealers
Developed Inventory Management and Inventory Viewer applications for MetroPCS to track phone inventory across branches and warehouses
Mentored developers, led code reviews, and introduced new technologies and best practices
 
Tech: C#, ASP.NET MVC, Knockout.js, Angular, jQuery, Bootstrap, WCF, REST API, SQL Server

projects.title: duesPlus
projects.description: Electronic bookkeeping and ticketing system for small organizations.

projects.title: Free Meter Order and Samples -  Ecommerce Project
projects.description: As the architect of the Samples & Free Meter site, my vision for this solution was one of complete sales order life cycle automation. I needed my sales force to have the ability to enter orders for promising prospects with ease & swiftness while having the entire backend process automated. This would allow them to focus on converting those prospects into customers and not waste valuable contact time and potentially lose the prospect by tracking down order status and shipment statuses of orders.
